_meta.amounts: All amounts are integers in CENTS and are EXCLUSIVE of GST. Every price in the source documents is quoted '+ GST'. GST handling is deferred (see spec 4C) but the portal must resolve it before any Pinch charge is made.
_meta.discount_rule: list_price is DERIVED, never stored independently: list = round(target / (1 - discount_pct)). Verified against every price in both source documents. Storing both figures independently guarantees drift.

_open_questions: Meta Ads, TikTok Ads and Influencer Marketing carry byte-identical tier pricing. Confirm this is a deliberate flat rate card and not copy-paste drift in the PandaDoc template BEFORE seeding production.

Weekly-priced services are displayed per week but billed monthly. The exact monthly figure is undefined: 52/12 weeks gives $1,685.67 for the $389/wk tier, while 4 weeks gives $1,556. Confirm with Sofia.
GST: all amounts above are ex-GST. Pinch charges a literal amount which must be GST-inclusive.
